## Digest storage v-final: one immutable file per commit under triediffs/ named… — 2026-07-25 (parent 0183137ec8fc)

The digest directory is renamed from `triediffs/` to `trie/triediffs/`, placing it in the trie-owned namespace to avoid collisions with user project directories. The package build excludes this path so digests never ship in wheels or sdists.

Two symbols are affected:

- `trie/config:Diff` — `diffs_dir` default changes to `"trie/triediffs"`
- `trie/init:PRE_COMMIT_HOOK_BLOCK` — the `git add` line in the hook now stages `trie/triediffs` instead of `triediffs`

The test `test_hook_block_includes_diff_write` is updated to assert the new `trie/triediffs` path, and `test_write_digest_files_symlink_and_prune` description is updated to reflect the new directory.
